articles.title: Indian Navy's P-8I aircraft arrives at Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam in Hawaii for RIMPAC 2026
articles.summary: The Indian Navy's P-8I Long Range Maritime Reconnaissance and Anti-Submarine Warfare (ASW) aircraft has arrived in Honolulu, Hawaii. It's participating in a major international naval exercise at Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam. This deployment underscores India's commitment to maritime security, fostering interoperability with global partners, and enhancing its strategic reach in the Indo-Pacific region.

articles.title: Putin 'is planning Polish incursion to test NATO's response'
articles.summary: Washington warns that the Kremlin is planning an armed incursion into Polish territory, specifically to test NATO's response. This potential provocation could involve Russian troops crossing into Poland and targeting vital infrastructure. Such an act would be a significant escalation, directly challenging NATO's collective defence principle (Article 5) and potentially triggering a broader international crisis.

articles.title: Iran’s Khamenei funeral: Which world leaders are attending?
articles.summary: Over 100 countries are expected to send representatives to the funeral of former Iranian Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, scheduled to begin on Friday, according to Iranian state-linked news. This significant international attendance underscores the global diplomatic engagement and attention surrounding such high-profile events involving key international figures, highlighting their geopolitical importance.

articles.title: Recent Watertown High School graduate to play baseball at Northeast Iowa CC
articles.summary: Recent Watertown High School graduate and pitcher Hunter Halajian has committed to play college baseball at Northeast Iowa Community College. This move signifies a significant step in his athletic and academic career, transitioning from high school to collegiate-level competition. It offers a chance to develop skills while pursuing higher education alongside his sports pursuits.

articles.title: Indian Army Agniveer Result 2026 date and time: Expected release soon, know steps to check at joinindianarmy.nic.in
articles.summary: The Indian Army Agniveer Result 2026 is anticipated to be released soon. Aspirants who appeared for the examination should regularly check the official website, joinindianarmy.nic.in, for updates on the exact date and time. This is a crucial announcement for candidates aiming to join the Indian Army through the Agniveer scheme, marking a significant step in their defence career.

articles.title: S.Korea presidential office rejects Coupang, US claims of discriminatory treatment
articles.summary: South Korea has rejected claims from e-commerce giant Coupang and a U.S. congressional report alleging that the company was unfairly targeted following a massive data breach. Seoul is defending its actions amid international scrutiny over the incident, which underscores ongoing debates about corporate accountability and governmental regulatory practices concerning data security.

articles.title: India’s space industry hunts for its SpaceX moment
articles.summary: India's private space program is showing early signs of success, three years after PM Modi's policy opened the sector to non-government firms. This initiative is fostering a vibrant private ecosystem, allowing companies to own spaceports and participate in launches. It signifies India's growing capabilities in space technology, promoting national self-reliance and technological advancement in a strategic domain, crucial for future growth.
